name: agentlint-workspace
description: Workspace for agentlint: deterministic triggers for contextual agent guidance and accountable resolution.
author: Aurelien Bobenrieth

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm fmt:check && intent validate packages/agentlint/skills && pnpm test && pnpm check:agentlint
scripts.check:agentlint: node packages/agentlint/dist/bin.mjs rules test && node packages/agentlint/dist/bin.mjs check --all --ci
